name.en-US: The Six Wings of the Seraph

description.la: Tractatus de sex alis Seraphim: sex virtutes praelati, zelus iustitiae, pietas compatiens, patientia, exemplaritas vitae, circumspecta discretio et devotio ad Deum. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Decem opuscula, 1900), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A treatise for superiors on the six wings of the seraph, six virtues of a prelate: zeal for justice, compassionate piety, patience, example of life, prudent discretion and devotion to God. The Latin is the Quaracchi text of the Decem opuscula (1900), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Tratado para superiores sobre as seis asas do serafim, seis virtudes do prelado: zelo da justiça, piedade compassiva, paciência, exemplaridade de vida, discrição prudente e devoção a Deus.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Decem opuscula ad theologiam mysticam spectantia, ed. 2 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1900).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1900 is public domain.
